references.text: The Lord speaks to Moses on Mount Sinai, the same pattern where God communicates directly with Moses
God speaks and gives instructions, introduction to the Ten Commandments with the same formula
The Lord calls Moses up the mountain to receive instructions, direct context before the tabernacle instructions
Same introductory formula: The Lord spoke to Moses, typical opening for divine instructions
The Lord speaks to Moses in the tabernacle, the same formula is used consistently throughout the books of Moses
Moses hears the voice of the Lord from the mercy seat in the tabernacle, fulfillment of the communication that begins here
Refers to Moses receiving instructions from God to build the tabernacle according to the heavenly pattern
Both verses mark the starting and ending points for the construction and setting up of the tabernacle.
